success.description: No numerical whole-output success is supplied for this exact fault model and budget. Existing AppendixA ordered-vector dependency, literal-equation and headline/data qualifications are retained. Equations18–20 give an expected survivor curve2^32*(1-2^-6)^n and threshold n>=968 for fewer than2^10 candidates per column; a mean threshold is not a probability bound on all columns. The45-fault construction forms1035 pairs by recombination with a shared correct output. Those pairs overlap; the source provides no joint independence or population success at45 faults.

components.description: Sections4.1–4.2: under the actual single-byte fault model, the true key satisfies the intended vector nonzero-difference constraints. This refers to the source intended relation, not a certification of the disputed literal scalar Equation13.

field_conflicts.label: Equation13 missing full inverse-MixColumns vector
field_conflicts.description: PrintedEq13 places one inverse-Sbox byte under each inverseMC row projection. IntendedEq12 filters a full four-byte vector. Literal scalar reading cannot implement the filter; a bounded wrong-key witness has all scalar differences nonzero while a true mixed byte iszero. The fullvector identity and no-zero property pass finite checks; no whole-construction failure is inferred.
